findings.finding: Independent L1 re-fetch spot check #4: 9 sampled rows (SRC-042, 045, 053, 061, 069, 077, 085, 093, 096), disjoint from flash-10 (rows 1-20), flash-11 (rows 21-40) and deepseek-flash-07 (rows 41,49,57,65,73,80,81,89). 7 MATCH, 2 PARTIAL (year-convention only), 0 FAIL, 0 FETCH_FAILED.
All 9 declared evidence excerpts ground in the fetched source text (content-token coverage >= 0.70); 0 not-found. Checked at abstract/metadata level, not page level.

Rows SRC-042, SRC-069 and SRC-077 carry a truncated INSPIRE search query (ending in an ellipsis) in exact_locator; it is not replayable. Their evidence_url resolves and was fetched. Locator hygiene only; no verdict depends on the truncated query.

The arXiv API returned persistent HTTP 429 for SRC-053 and SRC-085 while arxiv.org/abs/<id> returned 200; those rows use the abstract page as primary source (recorded as arxiv_abs fallback with fallback_for=arxiv). Verdicts unaffected.
Year conventions mix preprint-first-posting and journal years (SRC-061 ledger 2005 vs arXiv 2003; SRC-093 ledger 2009 vs arXiv 2005). Title and authors match in both cases.
